name: Plivo Phone
description: Plivo phone channel for OpenClaw. Real-time voice conversations over Plivo Audio Streaming, with barge-in and keypad input.

authToken.description: Plivo Auth Token from https://cx.plivo.com. Verifies inbound answer callbacks; keep it secret.

fromNumber.description: E.164 Plivo phone number the agent answers on and calls from.

publicWebhookUrl.description: Public https base URL Plivo reaches this plugin on, for example https://agent.example.com. Must forward WebSocket upgrades as well as HTTP, because the answer webhook and the audio stream share the origin.

answerPath.description: Local answer-webhook route registered in OpenClaw. Only change it when the default collides.

streamPath.description: Local WebSocket route Plivo connects the audio stream to.

autoWire.description: Create or update the Plivo application and attach the number at startup. Set false to configure Plivo by hand.

dmSecurity.description: Caller policy. allowlist restricts to allowFrom; open admits any number.

allowFrom.description: Caller numbers permitted when dmSecurity is allowlist. Digits only, no leading plus, because Plivo reports the caller without one.

idleTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds of caller silence before the call ends. 0 disables.
